verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents an official MCP server, both hosted at mcp.cal.com and runnable locally, for managing bookings, event types and schedules from any MCP-compatible client. A dedicated agents guide says API v2 lets agents check availability, create bookings and manage event types, backed by detailed slots, bookings and event-type endpoint docs and OAuth/API-key auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works in practice, and a published tool-by-tool listing of the MCP server's surface (no OpenAPI spec was found).
